scope_ko: 손 없이 서 있는 래브라도 머리를 마우스로 쓰다듬기: 피부 접촉에 따라 귀·고개·원본 눈 표정·국소 짧은 털·꼬리 반응
scope_en: Mouse-driven head petting on a standing Labrador without hands: real skin contact drives ears, head, original eyelids, local short coat and tail

native_app.codesign: Ad-hoc signature verified deep/strict after ASCII executable normalization; Korean display name retained

controls.preview: Hold LMB and slowly stroke the head
controls.native: F2 > Labrador petting; E/Esc leaves close view

limitations: Only two standing care loops are installed; attack, retrieval and feeding modules remain preparation.
Short fur is localized coat-surface deformation, not long-fur simulation.
Video shows two base loops. Interactive browser shows mouse reactions; Unity poster is an evaluated PreviewScene pose.
Native checks use deterministic screen-ray input; physical desktop input, focus and audible output are outside automated acceptance.
Original normal strength 0.2 preserved; Unity strength zero resolves verified torso normal/tangent shading seams.
Licensed binaries remain local; public code checkpoint uses the existing Unity baseline and scoped pet-only hooks.
